response.text:
The first progress report is due on Tue 15 Dec 2026 [item:itm_zse7bv6ce3s1]. To have it there on time, send it by Wed 9 Dec 2026 [item:itm_zse7bv6ce3s1].

- Submit it through the scholarship portal. It can be at most two pages, and your academic supervisor has to countersign it [doc:doc_pa2w9q3gxzqk].
- It comes from the Global Talent Scholarship 2026/27 award letter [doc:doc_pa2w9q3gxzqk].
